subject: F-11 gate still red: recorder test
summary: The gate is still red and I have not fixed it. `tests/test_recorder.py::test_scripted_session_produces_ordered_manifest_and_screenshots` fails at line 105. A click step's `window.process` is not `notepad++.exe`. I reproduced it in isolation (`pytest tests/test_recorder.py` gives 1 failed). I don't know the cause yet. It may be the new per-monitor DPI awareness shifting the coordinates, so the click lands on a different window than the scratch Notepad++. It may also be a flaky live-window overlap. I stopped before diagnosing it because Bash and PowerShell were then denied (don't-ask mode), so I could not print the recorded window or compare against a run without the DPI change. I added a temporary debug print to the test and removed it again, so the file is unchanged from where it started. Next step for whoever can run commands: print `s["window"]`, `rect`, `p1` and `p2` in that test. Then run it with `set_process_dpi_awareness()` disabled to see whether the DPI change causes the failure. I did not run ruff check, ruff format or the full pytest run after this failure, so none of those results are confirmed.
